newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Danzas sees higher 1998 operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Danzas sees higher 1998 operating profit.

text.p: Swiss freight forwarder Danzas AG said its restructuring was proceeding according to plans and would boost operating income starting in 1998.
"The group's restructuring project, which is expected to boost operating income substantially starting in 1998, progressed on schedule," the company said in a statement ahead of a news conference.
Group operating profit in 1996 rose to 8.0 million Swiss francs from 2.0 billion in 1995, while net income rose to 13 million, up from six million.

Peter Wagner, Danzas chief executive, said in the group's annual report that "the main objective for 1997 in to conclude uncompromisingly the changes that were initiated in 1996 and have been implemented throughout the group on the 'snowball principle'. This is the only way the ambitious goals can be met in the next few years."
